# GetHolocron

> GetHolocron is an AI-powered product development platform where every team member can experiment with ideas in real-time, see production-ready previews, share with their team, and ship to production.

## Overview

GetHolocron enables teams to evolve their products collaboratively. Every team member—from product managers to developers—can experiment with their ideas using AI-powered code changes and see instant, production-ready previews before sharing with the team.

## Key Features

### AI-Powered Development
- Natural language to code: Describe what you want, AI implements it
- Web search integration for contextual development
- Image search for finding visual assets
- Intelligent code analysis and suggestions

### Real-Time Previews
- Instant production-ready previews
- Live deployment to Vercel
- Branch-specific preview URLs
- Visual diff comparisons

### Team Collaboration
- Share previews with natural language summaries
- Approval workflows for production deployments
- Team comments and discussions
- Role-based permissions (owner, admin, editor, viewer)

### Integrations
- GitHub repository sync
- Vercel deployment automation
- Custom domain support

## Core Workflow

1. **Experiment**: Use AI + web search to prototype and iterate on ideas
2. **Preview**: See live, production-ready previews instantly
3. **Share**: Share previews with your team using natural language summaries
4. **Ship**: Deploy to production after team approval

## Target Users

- **Product Managers**: Experiment with feature ideas without waiting for dev resources
- **Developers**: Rapid prototyping and iteration with AI assistance
- **Design Teams**: See real implementations of design concepts
- **Startups**: Move fast from idea to production
- **Enterprise Teams**: Collaborative product evolution with approval workflows

## Getting Started

- Sign up: https://getholocron.com/auth
- Dashboard: https://getholocron.com/dashboard
- Documentation: https://getholocron.com

## Technical Stack

- Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Supabase (PostgreSQL, Edge Functions, Auth)
- Deployment: Vercel
- AI: Google Gemini, OpenAI GPT models

## Contact

- Website: https://getholocron.com
